module "M_LayerBlend.dss"

product 0 MaterialLayerBlend "B_LayerBlend" backend=Graph
  %0 = FunctionInput(BlendInputRelevance="Bottom", InputName="A", InputType="MaterialAttributes", IsOptional=true, SortPriority=0) : material @L5:C1 "A"
  %1 = FunctionInput(BlendInputRelevance="Top", InputName="B", InputType="MaterialAttributes", IsOptional=true, SortPriority=1) : material @L5:C1 "B"
  %2 = GetMaterialAttributes(MaterialAttributes=%0) : [BaseColor:float3, EmissiveColor:float3, Roughness:float, Normal:float3, Opacity:float, WorldPositionOffset:float3, FrontMaterial:Substrate, MaterialAttributes:material] @L7:C19 "BaseColor"
  %3 = GetMaterialAttributes(MaterialAttributes=%1) : [BaseColor:float3, EmissiveColor:float3, Roughness:float, Normal:float3, Opacity:float, WorldPositionOffset:float3, FrontMaterial:Substrate, MaterialAttributes:material] @L8:C19 "Roughness"
  %4 = MakeMaterialAttributes(BaseColor=%2, Roughness=%3#2) : material @L5:C1
  %5 = FunctionOutput(%4, OutputName="R", SortPriority=0) @L5:C1 "R"
  inputs %0, %1
  outputs %5
